}}'''Rosel of Essam''' was a scholar or author that lived approximately three hundred years after the breaking.

==History==
She documented a text she had access to about [[Ishamael]], the Betrayer of Hope, but only a fragment of a page survives. [[Verin]] is studying the manuscript page when [[Egwene]] visits and receives the [[Twisted stone ring]].{{ref/book|3|21}}
